How it works

Three things.
Every time you open it.

No complex dashboards. No wearable required. Just what matters — in 90 seconds a week.

1

Your Knee Age

A single number showing how your joints compare to your chronological age. 7 inputs at onboarding. Updated from 3 questions weekly.

2

Your weekly change

Is your Knee Age going up or down? An 8-week trend shows whether your lifestyle is protecting or ageing your joints.

3

Three actions to improve

Not twenty suggestions. Exactly three specific, evidence-based actions for this week — drawn from the R.E.P.A.I.R.™ framework built across 25 years of clinical practice.

4

Watch your joints get younger

As your behaviour improves, your score improves. The goal: make your Knee Age lower than your chronological age. Then keep it there.

Why it matters

Your joints are ageing.
Most people find out too late.

🦴
1 in 3 adults will develop knee OA
Osteoarthritis is the leading cause of disability worldwide. Yet no tool tracks joint health before pain starts.
530M people globally
📉
By the time it hurts, damage is done
The system is built to react. You see a surgeon when the pain is bad enough. Years of preventable decline have often already happened.
Biology-first, surgery-last
💪
Most joint ageing is reversible
Strength, sleep, load management, and metabolic health are all modifiable. Your joints at 60 largely reflect decisions made in your 40s and 50s.
Evidence-based

The science

Built on the R.E.P.A.I.R.™ framework

Every action is derived from six evidence-based pillars developed across 25 years of clinical orthopaedic practice.

R

Sleep, metabolic health, inflammation, nutrition
35%

10%
I

Surgery when genuinely indicated — last resort
5%

Lifelong joint preservation, relapse prevention
5%

Questions

Everything you need
to know.

Is this a medical app? +
No. OrthoLongevity™ is a wellness app. The Knee Age score is an educational estimate of joint resilience based on self-reported lifestyle and functional factors — not a medical diagnosis. It does not diagnose, treat, or manage any medical condition. If you have joint pain, always consult a qualified healthcare professional.
How is this different from my fitness tracker? +
Fitness trackers measure activity — steps, heart rate, sleep. OrthoLongevity™ specifically tracks the factors that determine joint health — strength, load management, stiffness, recovery, and symptom trends. No other platform translates these into a single joint-specific score and tells you what to do about it this week.
Do I need a wearable device? +
No. The weekly check-in takes 3 questions and under 90 seconds — no wearable required. The app can optionally pull step count from your phone automatically, but this is not required to generate your Knee Age score.
Who is this for? +
OrthoLongevity™ is designed for active adults aged 35–65 who want to protect their joint health before problems develop — runners, gym users, cyclists, and anyone who wants to stay active for longer. It is also valuable for people managing early knee pain, recovering from injury, or wanting to understand whether their lifestyle is protecting or ageing their joints.
When does the app launch? +
We are currently building the MVP and validating the Knee Age algorithm with real patients from Dr Arj's clinical practice. Waitlist members will be the first to access the app and will receive a personal email from Dr Arj when we launch.
Will it always be free? +
The app will launch with a free tier that includes your Knee Age score and weekly check-in. A premium subscription (planned at £9.99/month) will unlock personalised R.E.P.A.I.R.™ programmes, trend analysis, and priority access to clinical content.
